```{r load_data, include=FALSE}
# Load minimal data
data_list <- load_minimal_data(include_survival = TRUE)
dat_combined <- data_list$dat_combined

# Helper function for dates (from shared setup)
as_date_safe <- function(x) {
  v <- as.character(x)
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v))
  out <- rep(as.Date(NA), length(v))
  is_serial <- !is.na(num) & num > 20000 & num < 60000
  out[is_serial] <- as.Date(num[is_serial], origin = "1899-12-30")
  left <- !is_serial
  if (any(left)) {
    parsed <- suppressWarnings(lubridate::parse_date_time(v[left], orders = c("Y-m-d","m/d/Y","d/m/Y","m/d/y","d/m/y","Ymd"), tz = "UTC"))
    out[left] <- as.Date(parsed)
  }
  bad <- is.na(out) | lubridate::year(out) < 2000 | lubridate::year(out) > 2100
  out[bad] <- as.Date(NA)
  out
}
```

```{r define_universe, include=FALSE}
# Replicate Question 1 universe definition (38 unique patients, 48 patient-line observations)
# Universe: Patients with metastatic disease, palliative therapy lines, with ctDNA within 21 days before therapy start

# Get therapy start dates and settings
therapy_start_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*start.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
therapy_setting_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*treatment.*setting", ignore_case = TRUE))]

# Get all palliative therapy lines with dates
all_palliative_therapy_lines <- tibble(patient_id = character(0), therapy_line = integer(0), therapy_start_date = as.Date(character(0)))

if (length(therapy_start_cols) > 0 && length(therapy_setting_cols) > 0) {
  therapy_dates_with_lines <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, any_of(therapy_start_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "therapy_var", values_to = "start_date_raw") %>%
    mutate(
      start_date = as_date_safe(start_date_raw),
      therapy_line = as.integer(str_extract(therapy_var, "\\d+"))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(start_date), !is.na(therapy_line)) %>%
    select(patient_id, therapy_line, therapy_start_date = start_date)
  
  therapy_settings_with_lines <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, any_of(therapy_setting_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "setting_var", values_to = "setting_raw") %>%
    mutate(
      setting = as.character(setting_raw),
      therapy_line = as.integer(str_extract(setting_var, "\\d+"))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(therapy_line)) %>%
    select(patient_id, therapy_line, setting)
  
  all_palliative_therapy_lines <- therapy_dates_with_lines %>%
    left_join(therapy_settings_with_lines, by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line")) %>%
    mutate(
      setting_lower = tolower(setting),
      is_palliative = str_detect(setting_lower, "palliative|metastatic|1l.*metastatic|2l.*metastatic|3l.*metastatic")
    ) %>%
    filter(is_palliative) %>%
    select(patient_id, therapy_line, therapy_start_date) %>%
    arrange(patient_id, therapy_line)
}

# Get patients with metastatic disease
patients_with_metastatic <- dat_combined %>%
  filter(str_detect(tolower(as.character(metastatic_disease_ever_diagnosed_yes_no)), "yes|y|1")) %>%
  select(patient_id) %>%
  distinct()

# Get ctDNA data - be specific about column patterns to avoid type conflicts
# Look for ct_dna_level_1, ct_dna_level_2, etc. (numeric value columns)
ctdna_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^ct_dna_level_\\d+$|^ctdna_level_\\d+$", ignore_case = TRUE))]
ctdna_date_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^ct_dna_level_\\d+_date$|^ctdna_level_\\d+_date$", ignore_case = TRUE))]

ctdna_long <- tibble(patient_id = character(0), ctdna_date = as.Date(character(0)), ctdna_value = numeric(0))

if (length(ctdna_cols) > 0 && length(ctdna_date_cols) > 0) {
  ctdna_values <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, any_of(ctdna_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "ctdna_var", values_to = "ctdna_value_raw") %>%
    mutate(
      ctdna_idx = str_extract(ctdna_var, "\\d+"),
      ctdna_value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("^<\\s*", "", gsub(",", "", as.character(ctdna_value_raw)))))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ctdna_value)) %>%
    select(patient_id, ctdna_idx, ctdna_value)
  
  ctdna_dates <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, any_of(ctdna_date_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "ctdna_date_var", values_to = "ctdna_date_raw") %>%
    mutate(ctdna_idx = str_extract(ctdna_date_var, "\\d+"))
  
  ctdna_long <- ctdna_values %>%
    left_join(ctdna_dates, by = c("patient_id", "ctdna_idx")) %>%
    mutate(ctdna_date = as_date_safe(ctdna_date_raw)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ctdna_date)) %>%
    select(patient_id, ctdna_date, ctdna_value)
}

# Create universe: palliative therapy lines with ctDNA within 21 days before therapy start
universe <- all_palliative_therapy_lines %>%
  inner_join(patients_with_metastatic, by = "patient_id") %>%
  left_join(ctdna_long, by = "patient_id") %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(ctdna_date),
    ctdna_date <= therapy_start_date,
    ctdna_date >= (therapy_start_date - lubridate::days(21))
  ) %>%
  arrange(patient_id, therapy_line, desc(ctdna_date)) %>%
  group_by(patient_id, therapy_line, therapy_start_date) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(patient_id, therapy_line) %>%
  mutate(therapy_num = as.character(therapy_line))

cat("Question 1 Universe: ", nrow(universe), " patient-line observations (", length(unique(universe$patient_id)), " unique patients)\n")
```

```{r extract_treatments}
# Get therapy regimen columns
regimen_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*regimen|treatment.*regimen", ignore_case = TRUE))]
if (length(regimen_cols) == 0) {
  regimen_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^systemic_therapy_\\d+$", ignore_case = TRUE))]
}

# Get therapy setting columns
therapy_setting_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*treatment.*setting", ignore_case = TRUE))]

# Get note columns
note_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("systemic.*therapy.*note|treatment.*note", ignore_case = TRUE))]

# Create long format for regimens
regimen_long <- dat_combined %>%
  select(patient_id, any_of(regimen_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "regimen_var", values_to = "regimen_raw") %>%
  mutate(
    therapy_num = str_extract(regimen_var, "\\d+"),
    therapy_num = ifelse(is.na(therapy_num) | therapy_num == "", "all", therapy_num),
    regimen_orig = str_squish(as.character(regimen_raw)),
    regimen_clean = tolower(str_squish(as.character(regimen_raw))),
    regimen_clean = ifelse(is.na(regimen_clean) | regimen_clean == "", "unknown/not recorded", regimen_clean)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(regimen_orig) & regimen_orig != "") %>%
  select(patient_id, therapy_num, regimen_clean, regimen_orig)

# Get therapy settings
therapy_settings_long <- if (length(therapy_setting_cols) > 0) {
  dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, any_of(therapy_setting_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "setting_var", values_to = "setting_raw") %>%
    mutate(
      therapy_num = str_extract(setting_var, "\\d+"),
      therapy_num = ifelse(is.na(therapy_num) | therapy_num == "", "all", therapy_num),
      setting = str_squish(as.character(setting_raw)),
      is_palliative = str_detect(tolower(setting), "palliative|metastatic|1l.*metastatic|2l.*metastatic")
    ) %>%
    select(patient_id, therapy_num, is_palliative)
} else {
  # If no settings, assume all are palliative for metastatic cohort
  regimen_long %>%
    distinct(patient_id, therapy_num) %>%
    mutate(is_palliative = TRUE)
}

# Get notes - look for systemic therapy notes column (row 258 = systemic therapy notes)
# This is a general column, not therapy-specific
systemic_notes_col <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("systemic.*therapy.*note", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                          !str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*note", ignore_case = TRUE))]

# Get general systemic therapy notes column (row 258) - this is the main source for "see notes"
# Make sure we capture all patients, even if notes are empty (we'll filter later)
general_notes <- if (length(systemic_notes_col) > 0) {
  dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, all_of(systemic_notes_col[1])) %>%
    rename(systemic_notes = all_of(systemic_notes_col[1])) %>%
    mutate(
      systemic_notes = str_squish(as.character(systemic_notes)),
      systemic_notes = ifelse(is.na(systemic_notes) | systemic_notes == "", NA_character_, systemic_notes)
    ) %>%
    select(patient_id, systemic_notes)
} else {
  # If column not found, try to find it by checking all columns
  # Look for any column that might contain notes
  all_cols <- names(dat_combined)
  potential_cols <- all_cols[str_detect(all_cols, regex("note", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                             !str_detect(all_cols, regex("\\d+", ignore_case = TRUE)) &
                             !str_detect(all_cols, regex("date|time", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  
  if (length(potential_cols) > 0) {
    dat_combined %>%
      select(patient_id, all_of(potential_cols[1])) %>%
      rename(systemic_notes = all_of(potential_cols[1])) %>%
      mutate(
        systemic_notes = str_squish(as.character(systemic_notes)),
        systemic_notes = ifelse(is.na(systemic_notes) | systemic_notes == "", NA_character_, systemic_notes)
      ) %>%
      select(patient_id, systemic_notes)
  } else {
    # Return empty tibble with patient_id column for proper joining
    dat_combined %>%
      select(patient_id) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      mutate(systemic_notes = NA_character_) %>%
      select(patient_id, systemic_notes)
  }
}

# Get therapy-specific notes if available (for additional context)
therapy_notes_long <- if (length(note_cols) > 0) {
  dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, any_of(note_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "note_var", values_to = "note_raw") %>%
    mutate(
      therapy_num = str_extract(note_var, "\\d+"),
      therapy_num = ifelse(is.na(therapy_num) | therapy_num == "", "all", therapy_num),
      note_text = str_squish(as.character(note_raw))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(note_text) & note_text != "") %>%
    group_by(patient_id, therapy_num) %>%
    summarise(therapy_note = paste(unique(note_text), collapse = "; "), .groups = "drop")
} else {
  tibble(patient_id = character(0), therapy_num = character(0), therapy_note = character(0))
}

# Combine notes - for "see notes", use general systemic notes; otherwise prefer therapy-specific
# Make sure we join to ALL patient-therapy combinations, not just those with existing notes
notes_long <- regimen_long %>%
  distinct(patient_id, therapy_num) %>%
  left_join(general_notes, by = "patient_id") %>%
  left_join(therapy_notes_long, by = c("patient_id", "therapy_num")) %>%
  mutate(
    # For "see notes", use systemic_notes; for others, prefer therapy_note
    # Priority: systemic_notes (patient-level) > therapy_note (therapy-line-specific)
    note_filled = case_when(
      !is.na(systemic_notes) & systemic_notes != "" ~ systemic_notes,  # General notes available (for "see notes")
      !is.na(therapy_note) & therapy_note != "" ~ therapy_note,  # Fallback to therapy-specific
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(patient_id, therapy_num, note_filled, systemic_notes)

# Get the analysis universe from Question 1 (38 unique patients, 48 patient-line observations)
# The simplest approach: read the Question 1 Rmd to get the exact patient IDs
# But since we can't easily do that, we'll filter based on the same criteria:
# - Patients with metastatic disease
# - Palliative therapy lines
# - With baseline ctDNA (we'll identify these by checking if they appear in the Question 1 output)

# For now, we'll filter after joining - the key is to match the exact 48 patient-line observations
# We'll add a note that this should match Question 1's universe
cat("**Note:** This extraction is filtered to match the Question 1 analysis universe (38 unique patients, 48 patient-line observations).\n\n")

# We'll filter later after we have the full treatment list, matching to Question 1's universe
# For now, proceed with palliative therapy filter only - we'll add universe filter below

# Join everything together - filter to palliative therapy only AND Question 1 universe
# Check if universe exists (from define_universe chunk)
if (exists("universe") && nrow(universe) > 0) {
  patient_treatments <- regimen_long %>%
    inner_join(therapy_settings_long, by = c("patient_id", "therapy_num")) %>%
    filter(is_palliative) %>%
    # Filter to only patient-line combinations in Question 1 universe
    inner_join(universe, by = c("patient_id", "therapy_num")) %>%
    left_join(notes_long, by = c("patient_id", "therapy_num")) %>%
    mutate(
      # Check if regimen indicates "see notes" first (this takes priority)
      see_notes = str_detect(regimen_clean, regex("see.*note", ignore_case = TRUE)),
      # Check if regimen indicates clinical trial or other (only if not "see notes")
      is_clinical_trial = str_detect(regimen_clean, regex("clinical.*trial|trial|gco|hugo", ignore_case = TRUE)) & !see_notes,
      is_other = str_detect(regimen_clean, regex("other|unspecified", ignore_case = TRUE)) & !see_notes,
      # Extract the actual treatment information
      # If "see notes", replace the entire text with the note_filled value from systemic therapy notes column
      # For clinical trial or other, append note if available
      # Priority: use systemic_notes if available for "see notes", otherwise use note_filled
      treatment_display = case_when(
        see_notes & !is.na(systemic_notes) & systemic_notes != "" & systemic_notes != "NA" ~ systemic_notes,  # Use systemic notes for "see notes"
        see_notes & !is.na(note_filled) & note_filled != "" & note_filled != "NA" ~ note_filled,  # Fallback to note_filled
        see_notes ~ regimen_orig,  # Keep original if no note available
        is_clinical_trial & !is.na(note_filled) & note_filled != "" ~ paste0(regimen_orig, " (Note: ", note_filled, ")"),
        is_other & !is.na(note_filled) & note_filled != "" ~ paste0(regimen_orig, " (Note: ", note_filled, ")"),
        TRUE ~ regimen_orig
      )
    ) %>%
    select(patient_id, therapy_num, treatment_display, regimen_orig, note_filled)
} else {
  # Fallback if universe not defined - use all palliative therapy
  patient_treatments <- regimen_long %>%
    inner_join(therapy_settings_long, by = c("patient_id", "therapy_num")) %>%
    filter(is_palliative) %>%
    left_join(notes_long, by = c("patient_id", "therapy_num")) %>%
    mutate(
      see_notes = str_detect(regimen_clean, regex("see.*note", ignore_case = TRUE)),
      is_clinical_trial = str_detect(regimen_clean, regex("clinical.*trial|trial|gco|hugo", ignore_case = TRUE)) & !see_notes,
      is_other = str_detect(regimen_clean, regex("other|unspecified", ignore_case = TRUE)) & !see_notes,
      treatment_display = case_when(
        see_notes & !is.na(systemic_notes) & systemic_notes != "" & systemic_notes != "NA" ~ systemic_notes,
        see_notes & !is.na(note_filled) & note_filled != "" & note_filled != "NA" ~ note_filled,
        see_notes ~ regimen_orig,
        is_clinical_trial & !is.na(note_filled) & note_filled != "" ~ paste0(regimen_orig, " (Note: ", note_filled, ")"),
        is_other & !is.na(note_filled) & note_filled != "" ~ paste0(regimen_orig, " (Note: ", note_filled, ")"),
        TRUE ~ regimen_orig
      )
    ) %>%
    select(patient_id, therapy_num, treatment_display, regimen_orig, note_filled)
}

# Handle semicolons - if treatment_display contains ";", split into separate rows
# Each item separated by ";" represents a separate therapy line
patient_treatments_expanded <- patient_treatments %>%
  mutate(
    # Split by semicolon if present
    treatments_list = str_split(treatment_display, "; ")
  ) %>%
  unnest(cols = treatments_list) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment_display = str_trim(treatments_list),
    # Create new therapy line numbers for split treatments
    therapy_line_new = ifelse(str_detect(regimen_orig, ";"), 
                              paste0(therapy_num, ".", row_number()), 
                              therapy_num)
  ) %>%
  select(patient_id, therapy_num = therapy_line_new, treatment_display) %>%
  filter(!is.na(treatment_display) & treatment_display != "") %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(patient_id, suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_extract(therapy_num, "\\d+"))))

# Display the table
cat("## Patient Treatments by Therapy Line\n\n")
cat("**Patient ID, Therapy Line, and Systemic Treatment Received:**\n\n")
cat("Note: Treatments separated by ';' are shown as separate lines. For 'see notes', the value from systemic therapy notes column is extracted.\n\n")

patient_treatments_expanded %>%
  select(`Patient ID` = patient_id, 
         `Therapy Line` = therapy_num, 
         `Treatment` = treatment_display) %>%
  kable(caption = "Patient Treatments by Therapy Line (Palliative Setting Only)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)

# Classify treatments by therapy class (ADC, ICI, Chemo, Targeted, Other)
# Based on user guidance: classify each treatment line individually
patient_treatments_classified <- patient_treatments_expanded %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    treatment_lower = tolower(treatment_display),
    # Check for "see notes" or "n/a" - these should be classified as "n/a" or "Other"
    is_see_notes = str_detect(treatment_lower, regex("see.*note|other.*see.*note|clinical.*trial.*see.*note", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    # Pattern matching for therapy classes (check each individually)
    # ADC agents
    is_adc = str_detect(treatment_lower, regex("enfortumab|disitimab|sacituzumab|trastuzumab\\s*deruxtecan|dato.*dxd|bt8009|ff-10832", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    # ICI agents (pembrolizumab, nivolumab, atezolizumab, etc.)
    is_ici = str_detect(treatment_lower, regex("pembro|pembrolizumab|nivolumab|nivo\\b|atezo|atezolizumab|durva|durvalumab|relatlimab", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    # Chemotherapy agents
    is_chemo = str_detect(treatment_lower, regex("gem\\b|gemcitabine|cis\\b|cisplatin|carbo|carboplatin|oxaliplatin|taxol|docetaxel|folfox|folfiri|mvac|etoposide|eto", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    is_targeted = str_detect(treatment_lower, regex("erdafitinib|olaparib|loxo|fgfr|fx909|fx-909", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    # Special cases
    is_vaccine_trial = str_detect(treatment_lower, regex("pgv001|peptides.*poly.*iclc.*vaccine|vaccine.*atezolizumab|gco.*16-1387", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    is_intravesical = str_detect(treatment_lower, regex("intravesical", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    # Build class vector - check for combinations
    class_vec = list({
      vec <- c()
      if (is_adc) vec <- c(vec, "ADC")
      if (is_ici) vec <- c(vec, "ICI")
      if (is_chemo) vec <- c(vec, "Chemo")
      if (is_targeted) vec <- c(vec, "Targeted")
      if (is_vaccine_trial || is_intravesical) vec <- c(vec, "Other")
      vec
    }),
    # Determine final therapy class
    therapy_class = {
      # If "see notes" or unclear, classify as "n/a"
      if (is_see_notes && length(class_vec[[1]]) == 0) {
        "n/a"
      } else if (is_vaccine_trial) {
        "Other"
      } else if (is_intravesical) {
        "Other"
      } else {
        cv <- class_vec[[1]]
        if (length(cv) == 0) {
          # If no class detected and not "see notes", check for other patterns
          if (str_detect(treatment_lower, regex("clinical.*trial|trial|gco|hugo|hcrn", ignore_case = TRUE)) && !is_see_notes) {
            "Other"  # Clinical trial without clear class
          } else if (is_see_notes) {
            "n/a"
          } else {
            "unspecified"
          }
        } else if (length(cv) == 1) {
          cv[1]  # Single class
        } else {
          paste(cv, collapse = " + ")  # Combination
        }
      }
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(patient_id, therapy_num, treatment_display, therapy_class)

# Verify we have the correct counts (should be 38 unique patients, 48 patient-line observations)
n_unique_patients <- length(unique(patient_treatments_classified$patient_id))
n_total_lines <- nrow(patient_treatments_classified)

cat("\n**Verification:** This output shows ", n_unique_patients, " unique patients and ", n_total_lines, " patient-line observations.\n")
cat("Expected: 38 unique patients and 48 patient-line observations (matching Question 1 analysis universe).\n\n")

# Also create a summary by patient with alphabetical sorting
cat("\n## Summary by Patient\n\n")
cat("**All treatments received by each patient (palliative setting only), sorted alphabetically:**\n\n")

patient_summary <- patient_treatments_classified %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  arrange(treatment_display) %>%  # Sort treatments alphabetically within each patient
  summarise(
    `All Treatments` = paste(treatment_display, collapse = "; "),
    `N Therapy Lines` = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(patient_id)

patient_summary %>%
  kable(caption = "Summary of All Treatments by Patient (Alphabetically Sorted)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)

# Also create a summary with therapy class classification
cat("\n## Summary by Patient with Therapy Class Classification\n\n")
cat("**All treatments with therapy class (ADC, ICI, Chemo, Targeted, Other, n/a):**\n\n")
cat("Note: Treatments are sorted alphabetically. Therapy classes are shown in the same order.\n\n")

patient_summary_classified <- patient_treatments_classified %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  arrange(treatment_display) %>%  # Sort treatments alphabetically within each patient
  summarise(
    `All Treatments` = paste(treatment_display, collapse = "; "),
    `Therapy Classes` = paste(therapy_class, collapse = "; "),
    `N Therapy Lines` = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(patient_id)

patient_summary_classified %>%
  kable(caption = "Summary of All Treatments by Patient with Therapy Class Classification (Alphabetically Sorted)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)

```
